Question ID: MAR_U04_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.ECO.04

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Productivity and Energy Transfer
Stimulus: Productivity/energy data

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the population, interaction, food-web link, or cycle part. Then use the required stimulus (Productivity/energy data) to connect the visible evidence to marine populations, interactions, food webs, productivity, energy transfer, and matter cycling. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.ECO.04 and avoids this common mistake: reading a food web, graph, or cycle without tracing the direction of energy, matter, or population change.
